description:
We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead the clinical team at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA. This pivotal leadership role offers the opportunity to shape patient care, ensure regulatory compliance, and foster a supportive environment for nursing staff.

As the DON, you will be instrumental in maintaining the highest standards of quality care and operational excellence. We are looking to fill this vital full-time position promptly with a dedicated professional committed to making a significant impact on our residents' well-being. This role offers a competitive salary and the chance to join a compassionate and dedicated team.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Iowa
Minimum of 2-3 years of experience in a nursing leadership role, preferably as a DON or ADON
Demonstrated experience in a skilled nursing or long-term care setting
Strong knowledge of state and federal healthcare regulations
Excellent leadership, communication, and organizational skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: This full-time position offers a competitive salary ranging from $85,000 to $95,000 per year, commensurate with experience.
